ruleDefinitions.name: Hiding Files with Attrib.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of attrib.exe to hide files from users.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\attrib\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ATTRIB\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\+h\\ .*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\desktop\\\.ini\\ .*")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = "\+R\ \+H\ \+S\ \+A\ \\\*\.cui" AND parent_process_command_line = "C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\\*\.bat"))
